caption: I've bought R3 150 of 'deals' and Black Friday hasn't even happened. Is anyone else spending the sale before the sale?

slides.title:
The R3 150
of 'deals' I've bought
on R18 700 p/m
Living in Port Alfred
slides.body:
Male, 30
Single, no kids
Job: Marine fitter at a boatyard
Net salary: R18 700 p/m
It's the week before Black Friday

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: 1 bed flat near the harbour, water, refuse
slides.body: Cheaper than anything in Cape Town. Dearer than anyone here thinks it should be.

slides.title: 'Deals'
slides.includes: A smart watch, running shoes, a pressure washer, a gaming headset
slides.body: Every one was 'R800 off'. I've spent R3 150 to save R2 900. I understand how that sounds.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Pick n Pay, the braai pack on Fridays
slides.body: Meat is most of it. I'll defend that.

slides.title: Fuel
slides.includes: Petrol to the yard and back, the odd drive to Gqeberha
slides.body: The yard is 14 km from my flat. I don't mind until the pump.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My mom's rent top-up in Kenton-on-Sea
slides.body: She never asks. That's why I send it before she has to.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Prepaid electricity, car insurance, phone, funeral policy, stokvel, gym
slides.body: The gym is R350. I've been twice since August. The shoes are for that.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R18 700. And I haven't opened the actual Black Friday emails yet.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statements to Beyond Horizon and it grouped everything by category.

The 'deals' number isn't a category, but the card swipes were all there.

No bank login needed.
